name: Ngorongoro Conservation Area
description: In northern Tanzania, Ngorongoro Conservation Area protects highland plains, savanna and forest around the Ngorongoro Crater, the world's largest caldera. Wildlife shares the land with Maasai herders, and each year wildebeest, zebra and gazelles stream onto its northern plains. At Olduvai Gorge, researchers have found traces of human origins, including 3.6-million-year-old hominid footprints.
